item.title: 'Gruesome' war bets fuel calls for crackdown on prediction markets
item.summary: Predictions markets have hosted millions of dollars of bets related to the war in Iran.

item.title: BBC visits aftermath of Israeli strike on Lebanon that killed family as IDF targets Hezbollah
item.summary: A relative tells BBC those killed were civilians and not Hezbollah operatives, but the Israel Defence Forces says it was targeting "terrorist infrastructure".

item.title: The Papers: 'Starmer may send drones to the Gulf' and 'Panic hits the pumps'
item.summary: A mix of stories on Sunday's papers, with the war in the Middle East remaining prominent.

item.title: Russia exploiting Iran war, Zelensky says after fresh bombardment
item.summary: Volodymyr Zelensky cast concern over the supply of air-defence missiles after a heavy overnight attack kills at least five.

item.title: Iraq taking private plane to Mexico for World Cup play-off
item.summary: Iraq will travel to Mexico by private plane for their World Cup play-off despite calls from coach Graham Arnold to postpone the match amid the escalating US-Israeli war with Iran, the country's FA president Adnan Dirjal says.

item.title: Hamas urges key ally Iran to halt attacks on Gulf states
item.summary: The Palestinian group also affirms Tehran's right to defend itself from "aggression" by the US and Israel.

item.title: Under drone fire, exiled Kurds wait to confront Iranian regime
item.summary: A group of fighters based in Iraq say they are "ready to go home", as they face drone attacks from Tehran.

item.title: 'There's no hiding place on a ship': The sailors stranded near Iran
item.summary: Drones, cruise missiles and fighter jets have become a common sight for many sailors stranded on ships in the Gulf.

item.title: Bodies of 84 Iranian sailors killed in US torpedo strike to be repatriated
item.summary: The seamen died when Iranian warship the Iris Dena was sunk on 4 March by a US submarine near Sri Lanka.

item.title: 'Follow the smoke': BBC spends day with emergency teams as Israel strikes south Lebanon
item.summary: The BBC visited the city of Nabatieh, witnessing the pace and scale of Israel's bombing as its war with Hezbollah continues to escalate.
